اثنونيت (form XII)
# اِثْنَوْنَيْتُ (iṯnawnaytu) /iθ.naw.naj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِثْنَوْنَى (iṯnawnā)
# اِثْنَوْنَيْتَ (iṯnawnayta) /iθ.naw.naj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِثْنَوْنَى (iṯnawnā)
# اِثْنَوْنَيْتِ (iṯnawnayti) /iθ.naw.naj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِثْنَوْنَى (iṯnawnā)
